test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Magha Saaji is celebrated as Makar Sankranti in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Himachal Pradesh:

 
 
• ​Locals in Himachal Pradesh observe Magha Saaji as Makar Sankranti.
 
• Sankranti is known locally as Saaji, and the month is called Magha.
 
• People visit the temples on this day to seek the Lord's blessings and take a plunge in the area's sacred rivers.
